phisher_phoebe.name: Phisher Phoebe
phisher_phoebe.intro: This tape library is now under new management. Ours.
phisher_phoebe.defeat: I'll just... unsubscribe from this fight.
phisher_phoebe.after: Brute's at the back. He doesn't do subtle.

phisher_phineas.name: Phisher Phineas
phisher_phineas.intro: Your session has expired! Please battle to log back in.
phisher_phineas.after: We're not stealing the tapes. We're just making sure nobody can restore them.

brute_basement.name: Exploit Kit Brute
brute_basement.intro: Password. Password. Password! I try them ALL. Then I try them all AGAIN.
brute_basement.defeat: Locked out. Locked out. LOCKED OUT.
brute_basement.after: Zed's gonna hear about this. Zed. Zed. Zed.

scrum_master_sid.name: Scrum Master Sid
scrum_master_sid.intro: Quick stand-up: what did you do yesterday? What will you do today? Any blockers? Me. I'm the blocker.

qa_tess.name: QA Tess
qa_tess.intro: I found 400 bugs today. Let's see if you're 401.
qa_tess.after: Devi's Scriptfly automates anything it sees twice. Don't let it see you twice.

sre_raj.name: SRE Raj
sre_raj.intro: I'm on call. If my pager goes off mid-battle, you win by default.
sre_raj.after: Five nines of uptime. Zero nines of sleep.

devi_shah.name: Department Head Devi
devi_shah.intro: Devi Shah, DevOps. Someone got into my pipeline with a phished password. I'm in a mood. Let's deploy.
devi_shah.defeat: All green. Shipping you the Software Cert.
devi_shah.after: Ransom's been in and out of the old data center up north. Cron's old building. Be careful.

phisher_pam.name: Phisher Pam
phisher_pam.intro: Unauthorized access detected! That's you. We're the authorized ones now.
phisher_pam.after: Brute's guarding the aisle. Zed's guarding Cron.

phisher_paolo.name: Phisher Paolo
phisher_paolo.intro: Hot aisle, cold aisle, battle aisle!
phisher_paolo.after: The cooling's off on purpose. Cron says heat keeps people out.

brute_dc.name: Exploit Kit Brute
brute_dc.intro: YOU again. Again. AGAIN. This time I brought a bigger dictionary!

zed_dc.name: Exploit Kit Zed
zed_dc.intro: The help-desk kid again. You patch one hole and I find two more. Let's see your attack surface.
zed_dc.defeat: Huh. You're harder to get into than Port 443 was.
zed_dc.after: Cron's right behind me. He wants to meet you. Don't say I didn't warn you.
